method: exact Statevector probabilities of the decomposed Method A gate-based circuit (no measurement), plus a seeded multinomial draw and an independent Aer statevector run
ideal_reference_definition: noiseless statevector of the actual Method A circuit (Trotterized per-edge XY mixer) that is transpiled and run under noise
exact_vs_sampled: primary ideal metrics are from the exact circuit distribution; sampled metrics use the same shot count as the noisy run

trotterization_gap.definition: distance between the noiseless Method A circuit distribution (per-edge Trotterized XY mixer) and the Phase 3 exact weighted-subspace distribution (exact matrix exponential of the XY-ring sum)
trotterization_gap.note: the circuit realization is a first-order Trotter product of the XY-ring terms; the Phase 3 optimization used the exact exponential. Recorded here for transparency and kept separate from the noisy-vs-ideal comparison.
